verdicts.question: What type of roof is present at the site?

verdicts.question: Are there any obstructions on the roof that could affect the solar installation?
verdicts.photo_observation: Roof surface itself is clear, but a large tree canopy rises directly behind the ridge (pages 5, 10) and a large water tank sits on the adjacent terrace immediately west of the north array (layout pages 17-18; yellow tank page 10).
verdicts.rationale: No obstruction on the sheet itself, but the adjacent tree and water tank may cast shade; photos cannot confirm sun direction/timing.

verdicts.question: What is the angle of the panels? (in degrees)
verdicts.photo_observation: Low-pitch gable sheet roof with a shallow ridge (pages 8, 10); visual slope roughly 8-12 degrees; panels to be flush-mounted on sheet.
verdicts.rationale: Flush mini-rail mounting means panel angle = roof slope; shallow pitch in photos is consistent with 8 degrees.

verdicts.question: In case of sloped roof, what is the slope angle of the roof? (in degrees)
verdicts.photo_observation: Gable sheet roof ridge visible on pages 8 and 10; slope appears shallow, roughly 8-12 degrees.

verdicts.question: On how many roofs at the site are we installing solar?
verdicts.photo_observation: Proposed PV Area overlays (page 10) and 3D layout (pages 17-18) place all 5 panels on one gable sheet roof (2 on one plane, 3 on the other). A separate lower sheet roof (page 7 left, page 11) is not used.
verdicts.rationale: Single roof structure carries the whole array; designer's '1' matches.

verdicts.question: What type of mounting structure is planned?
